beats.care: Running or cheering? Take the Red, Yellow, Blue or Violet Line from 3:30 am. Other lines start at normal Sunday times.
beats.what: The Vedanta Delhi Half Marathon is on Sunday. Runners will skip Rail Bhawan, Sansad Marg and Patel Chowk, and loop near Kartavya Path instead.
beats.why: Organisers say heavy police barricading at those spots after recent protests forced the change. DMRC is starting four lines early so runners arrive on time.

cards.body: Organisers Procam International expect more than 40,000 people across all the races on Sunday.
cards.caption: runners expected

cards.body: From 3:30 am to 4:15 am, trains come every 15 minutes. From 4:15 am to 6 am, they come every 20 minutes. After 6 am, the normal Sunday timetable runs.

cards.body: The Open 10K usually starts at Sansad Marg. This year it starts at Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium at 7:35 am instead.
